neighbours.label: a definite or universal determiner right after 'with' / 'con' / 'avec' (with the, with all, con el, avec les); the - pole is the indefinite 'with a'
fire: She topped the soup with the fresh herbs from her garden.
He finished the speech with all the energy he had left.
Mezcle el arroz y cubra con los frijoles negros antes de servir.
The team arrived with the trophy held high above their heads.
Decore el pastel con la crema batida y unas fresas.
They filled the old barn with the hay from the north field.
We stayed up late with the neighbors talking about the storm.
Il a nettoyé la cuisine avec les produits que sa mère lui avait donnés.
quiet: She topped the soup with a handful of herbs from her garden.
He finished the speech in a hurry and left the stage.
Mezcle el arroz y cubra con unos frijoles negros antes de servir.
The team arrived at dawn holding a trophy high above their heads.
Decore el pastel con una crema batida y unas fresas.
They filled an old barn with hay from the north field.
We stayed up late on the porch talking about the storm.
Il a nettoyé la cuisine avec des produits que sa mère lui avait donnés.

notes: Card: top + examples are 'con los', 'con el', 'with all', 'all the', 'toutes les'; - pole is ' a' after 'With' (28 of top 32). Near misses use 'with a/some' or determiners after other prepositions.
